enum Program{
R0(representation_0::State),
R1(representation_1::State),
R2(representation_2::State),
R3(representation_3::State),
}
impl Program{
fn new(index:usize)->Result<Self,String>{match index{
0=>Ok(Self::R0(representation_0::State::new()?)),
1=>Ok(Self::R1(representation_1::State::new()?)),
2=>Ok(Self::R2(representation_2::State::new()?)),
3=>Ok(Self::R3(representation_3::State::new()?)),
_=>Err("unknown compiled representation".into())}}
fn restore(index:usize,bytes:&[u8])->Result<Self,String>{match index{
0=>Ok(Self::R0(representation_0::State::restore(bytes)?)),
1=>Ok(Self::R1(representation_1::State::restore(bytes)?)),
2=>Ok(Self::R2(representation_2::State::restore(bytes)?)),
3=>Ok(Self::R3(representation_3::State::restore(bytes)?)),
_=>Err("unknown compiled representation".into())}}
fn invoke_json(&mut self,name:&str,args:&Json)->Result<Json,String>{match self{
Self::R0(state)=>state.invoke_json(name,args),
Self::R1(state)=>state.invoke_json(name,args),
Self::R2(state)=>state.invoke_json(name,args),
Self::R3(state)=>state.invoke_json(name,args),
}}
fn checkpoint(&self)->Result<Vec<u8>,String>{match self{
Self::R0(state)=>state.checkpoint(),
Self::R1(state)=>state.checkpoint(),
Self::R2(state)=>state.checkpoint(),
Self::R3(state)=>state.checkpoint(),
}}
fn version(&self)->u64{match self{
Self::R0(state)=>state.version(),
Self::R1(state)=>state.version(),
Self::R2(state)=>state.version(),
Self::R3(state)=>state.version(),
}}
fn acknowledge_through(&mut self,commit:u64,position:u64){match self{
Self::R0(state)=>state.acknowledge_through(commit,position),
Self::R1(state)=>state.acknowledge_through(commit,position),
Self::R2(state)=>state.acknowledge_through(commit,position),
Self::R3(state)=>state.acknowledge_through(commit,position),
}}
fn switch(&mut self,index:usize)->Result<(),String>{let bytes=self.checkpoint()?;let next=Self::restore(index,&bytes)?;*self=next;Ok(())}
}

const SOURCE:&str="module filtered_aggregate;\nenum Error{Failed,}\nrecord Row{value:u64,active:Bool,}\nstate Rows:Table<u64,Row> = Table.empty();\nkeep total:u64 = sum(Rows.values().filter(fn(row)=>row.active).map(fn(row)=>row.value));\nkeep size:u64 = sum(Rows.values().filter(fn(row)=>row.active).map(fn(row)=>row.value*0+1));\nevent seen:u64;\nchange put(key:u64,value:u64,active:Bool,fail:Bool)->Result<Unit,Error> writes(Rows) emits(seen){\n if Rows.contains(key){Rows.replace(key,Row{value:value,active:active});}else{Rows.insert(key,Row{value:value,active:active});}\n emit seen(value);if fail{return Err(Error.Failed);}return Ok(());\n}\nchange erase(key:u64,fail:Bool)->Result<Unit,Error> writes(Rows) emits(seen){Rows.remove(key);emit seen(key);if fail{return Err(Error.Failed);}return Ok(());}\nquery total_query()->u64 reads(total){return total;}\nquery count_query()->u64 reads(size){return size;}\n";
use std::{hint::black_box,time::Instant};
use verified_language::{core::CheckedModule,stateful::Runtime,syntax::parse};
fn call(i:usize,reads:usize,count:usize,query:&str)->(&str,Json){
 if i%100<reads{(query,json!([]))}else{let key=(i*17%count.max(1))as u64;match i%4{
  0=>("erase",json!([key,false])),1=>("put",json!([key,u64::MAX-i as u64,true,false])),
  2=>("put",json!([key,i,false,false])),_=>("put",json!([count as u64+i as u64,i,true,false]))}}
}
fn main(){
 let module=CheckedModule::from_source(parse(SOURCE).unwrap()).unwrap();
 let labels=["direct","refresh","sum-delta","count-delta"];
 let selected=std::env::var("INK_BENCH_CANDIDATES").unwrap_or(labels.join(","));
 let selected=selected.split(',').collect::<Vec<_>>();assert!(selected.iter().all(|s|labels.contains(s)));
 let queries=std::env::var("INK_BENCH_QUERIES").unwrap_or("total_query,count_query".into());
 let queries=queries.split(',').collect::<Vec<_>>();assert!(queries.iter().all(|s|["total_query","count_query"].contains(s)));
 let reads=std::env::var("INK_BENCH_READS").unwrap_or("100,90,50,10,0".into());
 let reads=reads.split(',').map(|s|s.parse::<usize>().unwrap()).collect::<Vec<_>>();assert!(reads.iter().all(|r|*r<=100));
 let rounds=std::env::var("INK_BENCH_ROUNDS").unwrap_or("5".into()).parse::<usize>().unwrap();assert!((1..=20).contains(&rounds));
 let sizes:Vec<usize>=std::env::var("INK_BENCH_ROWS").unwrap_or("48,256,1024,2048,4000".into()).split(',').map(|s|s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
 assert!(!sizes.is_empty()&&sizes.len()<=16&&sizes.iter().all(|n|*n>0&&*n<=4000));
 let mut measurements=vec![];let mut phases=vec![];
 for count in sizes{
  let mut initial=Runtime::new(module.program().clone()).unwrap();
  let rows=(0..count).map(|i|(i as u64,(i as u64*13+7,i%3!=0))).collect::<std::collections::BTreeMap<_,_>>();
  for (key,(value,active)) in &rows{initial.invoke_json("put",&json!([key,value,active,false])).unwrap();initial.acknowledge_through(u64::MAX,u64::MAX);}
  let bytes=initial.checkpoint_portable().unwrap();
  let mut order=(0..labels.len()).collect::<Vec<_>>();if std::env::var_os("INK_BENCH_REVERSE").is_some(){order.reverse();}
  for index in order{
   if !selected.contains(&labels[index]){continue;}
   let start=Instant::now();let mut initialized=Program::restore(index,&bytes).unwrap();let initialise_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();
   let start=Instant::now();initialized.switch((index+1)%labels.len()).unwrap();let migration_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();
   assert_eq!(initialized.checkpoint().unwrap(),bytes);
   phases.push(json!({"rows":count,"candidate":labels[index],"initialise_ns":initialise_ns,"portable_migration_ns":migration_ns}));
   for &query in &queries{for reads in &reads{
    let mut samples=vec![];
    for round in 0..rounds{
     let mut native=Program::restore(index,&bytes).unwrap();let mut baseline=Runtime::restore_portable(module.program().clone(),&bytes).unwrap();
     let script=(0..100).map(|i|call(i+round*100,*reads,count,query)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
     let start=Instant::now();let actual=script.iter().map(|(name,args)|{let reply=native.invoke_json(name,args).unwrap();native.acknowledge_through(u64::MAX,u64::MAX);black_box(reply)}).collect::<Vec<_>>();let native_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();
     let start=Instant::now();let expected=script.iter().map(|(name,args)|{let reply=baseline.invoke_json(name,args).unwrap().json();baseline.acknowledge_through(u64::MAX,u64::MAX);black_box(reply)}).collect::<Vec<_>>();let baseline_ink_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();assert_eq!(actual,expected);
     let mut hand=rows.clone();let mut version=count as u64;
     let start=Instant::now();let scanner=script.iter().map(|(name,args)|{
      let read=*name==query;let result=if read{json!(hand.values().filter(|(_,active)|*active).fold(0u64,|n,(v,_)|n.wrapping_add(if query=="total_query"{*v}else{1})))}else{
       let key=args[0].as_u64().unwrap();if *name=="erase"{hand.remove(&key);}else{hand.insert(key,(args[1].as_u64().unwrap(),args[2].as_bool().unwrap()));}version+=1;json!({"Ok":null})};
      let events=if read{json!([])}else{json!([{"commit":version,"position":0,"channel":"seen","value":if *name=="erase"{args[0].clone()}else{args[1].clone()}}])};
      black_box(json!({"result":result,"committed":!read,"version":version,"events":events}))
     }).collect::<Vec<_>>();let handwritten_rust_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();assert_eq!(actual,scanner);
     let mut hand=rows.clone();let mut sum=hand.values().filter(|(_,active)|*active).fold(0u64,|n,(v,_)|n.wrapping_add(*v));let mut active_count=hand.values().filter(|(_,active)|*active).count()as u64;let mut version=count as u64;
     let start=Instant::now();let maintained=script.iter().map(|(name,args)|{
      let read=*name==query;let result=if read{json!(if query=="total_query"{sum}else{active_count})}else{
       let key=args[0].as_u64().unwrap();let old=if *name=="erase"{hand.remove(&key)}else{let row=(args[1].as_u64().unwrap(),args[2].as_bool().unwrap());let old=hand.insert(key,row);if row.1{sum=sum.wrapping_add(row.0);active_count+=1;}old};if let Some((v,true))=old{sum=sum.wrapping_sub(v);active_count-=1;}version+=1;json!({"Ok":null})};
      let events=if read{json!([])}else{json!([{"commit":version,"position":0,"channel":"seen","value":if *name=="erase"{args[0].clone()}else{args[1].clone()}}])};
      black_box(json!({"result":result,"committed":!read,"version":version,"events":events}))
     }).collect::<Vec<_>>();let handwritten_incremental_rust_ns=start.elapsed().as_nanos();assert_eq!(actual,maintained);
     assert_eq!(native.checkpoint().unwrap(),baseline.checkpoint_portable().unwrap());
     samples.push(json!({"round":round,"native_ns":native_ns,"baseline_ink_ns":baseline_ink_ns,"handwritten_rust_ns":handwritten_rust_ns,"handwritten_incremental_rust_ns":handwritten_incremental_rust_ns}));
    }
    measurements.push(json!({"rows":count,"candidate":labels[index],"query":query,"read_percent":reads,"calls_per_sample":100,"samples":samples}));
   }}
  }
 }
 println!("{}",json!({"schema":2,"scope":"ordinary compiled representation programs; complete JSON replies and events; caller-trusted typed inputs; acknowledgement per call; no call-time logical snapshots or proof objects; initialization/migration/checkpoints excluded from steady state; harness links source baseline solely for comparison and outside-loop setup","phases":phases,"measurements":measurements}));
}
